name: After diagnosing a recurring clog, what are my options for repair?

mainEntity.name: After diagnosing a recurring clog, what are my options for repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: After diagnosing a recurring clog, your repair options will depend on the identified cause. For issues like tree roots, options may include hydro-jetting to clear roots and pipe lining or replacement to prevent recurrence. For damaged pipes, repair or replacement of the affected section might be necessary. CG Plumbing Solutions will present a clear explanation of the findings and discuss the most effective, long-term solutions tailored to your specific situation and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair options for recurring clogs depend on the cause, ranging from hydro-jetting for roots to pipe repair or replacement for damage. We will explain the findings and discuss suitable long-term solutions.
